📑 Rewriting history
- A lot faster EasyWorship import
- Importing from another application will create its own category
- Updated initialize popup looks
- All project folders will open when creating a new folder inside
- Section focus on create
- fixed freeze when creating a new show with text, when another show is active without any slides
- Undo slides
- Duplicating a slide will keep its position
